name: cc-beautifier
description: Tidies Claude Code's transcript: folds every tool call row into a box named by its tool, with a copy-all button, marks your prompts and Claude's replies with a coloured bar, and can show when each message came

fold.title: Fold tool messages
fold.description: Fold every tool call row into a box that opens on a click

time.title: Show message time
time.description: Show the time of each prompt, reply and tool call at the end of its row

highlight.title: Highlight conversation
highlight.description: Mark your own prompts and Claude's replies to you with a coloured bar on their left
